description:
Address autocomplete (type-ahead): ranked, standardized address suggestions for a
    partial input `q` (typed so far), with lat/lng whenever the reference row
    carries a coordinate. Use it to help a person pick an address, then pass
    the chosen one to validate_address.

    `country` is ISO-3 lowercase. `limit` 1-50 (default 10). `state` narrows
    USA/Canada. For UK (gbr) the query may be, or start with, a postcode:
    a full or partial postcode returns every delivery point there (labelled
    with building/organisation names). UK requests are served from the Royal
    Mail PAF service; suggestions do not carry UDPRN/UPRN, so validate the
    chosen address to get them.

    Cost: billed exactly like the /suggest endpoint it wraps; see
    https://www.acuris-geo.com/acuris-pricing/
name: autocomplete_address
